ValidationRule.description: Requires either a Vehicle Model (catalogue-level) or a Selected Vehicle (specific inventory unit) from Explore stage onward — either satisfies the gate.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Explore"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Select"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Commit"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Take the Keys"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won")), ISBLANK(AF_VehicleModel__c), ISBLANK(AF_SelectedVehicle__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A vehicle model or selected vehicle is required from Explore stage onward.
